# hetznerrobot_rdns_entries (Data Source)

Lists the reverse DNS entries of the account, or of one server.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Every entry of one server; leave server_ip out for the whole account.
data "hetznerrobot_rdns_entries" "web" {
  server_ip = "123.123.123.123"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `server_ip` (String) Main IP address of a server; only its entries are listed.

### Read-Only

- `entries` (Attributes List) The reverse DNS entries. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--entries))

<a id="nestedatt--entries"></a>
### Nested Schema for `entries`

Read-Only:

- `ip` (String) IP address.
- `ptr` (String) PTR record.
